Name: Kingler Dog Replacer
Author: ruckeysquad
Description:
Ever wanted a pet Kingler, well here you go.

this mod simply replaces the dogs sprites with those of a kingler.

these sprites are slightly modified versions of the companion sprites from pokemon heart gold/soul silver

works with the most recent version of stardew valley as of  "November 3rd 2016"

TO INSTALL:

just drag and drop into your main stardew valley folder, you should be good.

also remember to make a backup
